name: World Bank Indicators API (v2)
dataKind: Annual country and world economic and trade indicators (historical statistics)
browserAccessNote: A cross-origin request from a browser was blocked: the API sends no Access-Control-Allow-Origin header (tested 2026-11-17). eport therefore does not call it from the page.
coverage: Around 200 economies plus the world aggregate; coverage varies by indicator and year. Missing observations are left missing.
freshness: Annual observations. Each figure shows the World Bank's database update date and the date eport retrieved it.
attribution: Source: World Bank, World Development Indicators.
rateLimit: Not applicable at runtime — four requests per snapshot refresh.
usedBy: Home and Intelligence: world trade indicators
notes: Retrieved at build time and published as dated static files, as the CC BY 4.0 licence permits. Values are historical statistics, not live data; the publisher may revise recent years.

name: Frankfurter
dataKind: Daily reference exchange rates published by central banks
browserAccessNote: A cross-origin request from a browser succeeded; the response carries Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * (tested 2026-11-17).
coverage: Currencies with published central-bank reference rates; not every ISO 4217 currency. eport checks the provider's currency list before requesting a rate.
freshness: Updated on working days. Reference rates only — not tradable, bank or customs rates.
license: Open-source service; underlying rates published by central banks.
rateLimit: No API key or published quota. eport caches rates in the browser for 6 hours and the currency list for 7 days.
usedBy: Planned: Trade Cost Explorer currency conversion (Phase 3)
notes: Called live from the browser. Your browser sends only the currency codes being requested.

name: Digitraffic Marine
dataKind: AIS vessel locations and metadata, port calls
browserAccessNote: Response carried Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * (checked 2026-11-17). The service requires gzip, which browsers send by default.
coverage: Vessels received by Finnish AIS base stations — the Baltic Sea around Finland only. Not global coverage.
freshness: Near real time for vessels inside the coverage area.
attribution: Source: Fintraffic / digitraffic.fi, licence CC BY 4.0.
rateLimit: Published fair-use limits apply; a Digitraffic-User identification header is requested by the operator.
usedBy: Planned: Maritime Intelligence regional vessel layer (Phase 4)
notes: When integrated, eport will label this as regional coverage. It must never be presented as a global vessel feed.

name: UN Comtrade API
dataKind: Bilateral merchandise trade statistics by HS commodity
browserAccessNote: The keyless preview endpoint returned no Access-Control-Allow-Origin header (checked 2026-11-17). Full access needs a subscription key, which cannot be placed in a static site.
coverage: Most reporting economies; detailed bilateral flows by commodity.
freshness: Annual and monthly, as reported by national statistical offices.
notes: Coming Soon — requires a secure integration layer. Until then eport links users to the official UN Comtrade website.

name: AISHub
browserAccessNote: Not tested: access requires membership and a personal credential, which cannot be placed in a static site.
notes: Coming Soon — requires a secure integration layer and a data-sharing membership.

name: Wikipedia search API (MediaWiki Action API)
dataKind: Encyclopedia articles matching a search (title, short extract)
browserAccessNote: A cross-origin request succeeded; the response carries Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * (tested 2026-11-17).
coverage: English Wikipedia. General-interest — not a trade authority.
freshness: Live; articles are edited by volunteers at any time.
attribution: Text from Wikipedia contributors, CC BY-SA 4.0.
rateLimit: No key; reasonable use. eport caches each query in the browser for 30 minutes.
notes: Context only. Shown as unverified web content and never used as the basis of a trade requirement. The visitor's search words are sent to Wikipedia.

name: GDELT DOC 2.0 API
dataKind: Headlines of recent online news articles matching a query
browserAccessNote: A cross-origin request succeeded; the response carries Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * (tested 2026-11-17). It answers HTTP 429 when called more than about once every 5 seconds.
coverage: Global online news in many languages; eport requests English. Sources are not vetted by eport.
freshness: Near real time (articles typically appear within minutes to hours).
license: Open data; each headline and article belongs to its publisher.
attribution: Headlines indexed by the GDELT Project; each belongs to its publisher.
rateLimit: About one request per 5 seconds per client; eport caches each query for 30 minutes and shows a clear message when limited.
notes: Headlines only (no images, no article text). Includes sources of varying quality, so results are labelled as unverified.

name: Official publisher RSS feeds
operator: WTO, ITC, European Commission, ICC, United Nations
dataKind: Headlines, short abstracts and links from publishers' syndication feeds
browserAccessNote: Feeds are retrieved by a build-time script, not by the browser, because RSS feeds are not offered for cross-origin browser requests. A GitHub Action refreshes them daily.
coverage: Five publishers; newest 10 items per feed, up to 60 items overall.
freshness: Snapshot refreshed daily; each page shows the retrieval date.
license: Syndication feeds published for redistribution of headlines and links.
attribution: Headline and abstract belong to the named publisher; each item links to the original.
usedBy: Home and News page: latest trade news
notes: Only what the feed provides is kept — never article bodies. A feed that fails keeps its previous items and is flagged.

name: Nager.Date public holiday API
dataKind: Public holidays by country and year
browserAccessNote: A cross-origin request succeeded; the response carries Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * (tested 2026-11-17).
coverage: Many countries, not all. Some — including India on the day of testing — answer with no data (HTTP 204); eport then says holidays are unavailable rather than guessing.
freshness: Published per calendar year; national and regional holidays can be announced or changed late.
rateLimit: No key or published quota. eport caches each country-year in the browser for 24 hours.
notes: Informational only — confirm working days with the relevant customs authority and carrier. Regional and religious observances may be missing.

name: World Bank WITS — trade statistics API (SDMX)
dataKind: Merchandise trade by partner and by product sector, as reported by each reporting country
browserAccessNote: The API response carried no Access-Control-Allow-Origin header (checked 2026-11-18), so a browser cannot call it from eport.live. eport reads it at build time and publishes dated static files, as the CC BY 4.0 licence permits.
coverage: 152 reporting countries for 2023. WITS answers "NoRecordsFound" for countries that did not report (for example Russia, Algeria and the Democratic Republic of the Congo for 2023); eport does not estimate them or mix in other years.
freshness: Annual. The newest year with broad coverage is used for every country so figures are comparable.
attribution: Source: World Bank, World Integrated Trade Solution (WITS), based on UN Comtrade data as reported by each country.
rateLimit: Not applicable at runtime. The build script uses four parallel requests with retries.
usedBy: Country pages: trade partners and sectors
notes: Goods only (no services). Exporter and importer reports of the same flow rarely match (freight and insurance valuation, timing, re-exports); eport shows both and states the gap.
